artNote: Original illustrations for 18과 are still to be drawn, so no question carries art yet. None of them needs one to be answerable: every question is about a form the chapter prints, a feeling or a weather word it names, or its closing 발음 review.

questions.q: Which of the chapter’s four forms says how long it has been since something was done?
"한국에 ___ 벌써 네 달 됐어요." Which fits?
Why is 온 지 written with a space, when 하지 마세요 is not?

choices.A: it is not — both are written together
choices.B: the 지 of V-(으)ㄴ 지 is a noun of its own, meaning the time since
choices.C: the space marks a question, as in 지요
choices.D: any 지 after a past verb takes a space

questions.q: After V-(으)ㄴ 지 and a length of time, which verb does the chapter use?
In 아니에요, 두 그릇이나 먹었어요, what does 이나 say?

choices.A: that two bowls is more than you would expect
choices.B: that it was only two bowls
choices.C: two bowls, or something else instead
choices.D: that the bowls were unusually big

questions.q: "민영 씨는 개가 다섯 마리___ 있어요." Which fits after the vowel of 리?
What is the difference between 세 잔이나 마셨어요 and 세 잔밖에 안 마셨어요?

choices.A: nothing — the two mean the same
choices.B: the first is cups, the second glasses
choices.C: the same three cups, counted as a lot in the first and as few in the second
choices.D: the first is a question and the second its answer

questions.q: "나는 자기 전에 책을 ___." Which is the plain style?
Which sentence is the plain style of an adjective?
What does 놀다 become in the plain style?
The plain style of 여기는 학교예요 and 오늘은 방학이에요 is:
Why does 사계절이 있다 take no -는다, when 책을 읽는다 does?

choices.A: because 사계절 is a long word
choices.B: because 있다 is irregular in every ending
choices.C: because 있다 meaning "there is" counts as an adjective, like 없다
choices.D: it should — 사계절이 있는다 is the plain style

questions.q: Which of the chapter’s feelings is missing someone or somewhere far away?
What is the chapter’s word for the long rains that begin at the end of June?
What new pronunciation rule does 18과’s 발음 page teach?

choices.A: 유음화 — a ㄴ read as [ㄹ] next to a ㄹ
choices.B: none — the page reviews rules taught earlier
choices.C: 구개음화 — ㄷ and ㅌ read as [ㅈ] and [ㅊ] before 이
choices.D: the ㅎ-irregular of adjectives such as 하얗다

questions.q: On that page, how is the underlined 작년 said?
